headline: Belgium and Spain nick it while Rosaria takes the tumble
text: A tidy little shake-up in the sweepstake: Belgium (Vicki) and Spain (Grandad) both came out on top, while England (Alex) just about scraped past Mexico (Rosaria). The big winner from the round is Vicki, with Belgium flying, but Rosaria took the worst of it and England’s win did little to lift Alex. Overall, Max is still bossing it at the top on 29 points, with Grandad and Vicki breathing down the neck of the leader. At the bottom, Sofia remains in bother on 10 points, with Christopher not far ahead and still well off the pace.
